responsibility: Implements the main C++ backend logic for the CRIS target, complementing the md files with target hooks and helper routines. It owns CRIS option override and tuning state, per-function machine data, calling convention and varargs handling, prologue/epilogue and return expansion, frame layout and elimination offsets, address validation and operand printing, asm and thunk/trampoline emission, register/move/cost and alignment hooks, condition-code mode selection, libfunc and builtin setup, inline-asm adjustment, and the CRIS post-delay-slot compare-elimination RTL pass.
same_name_distinction: Unlike cris.h, cris.md, and cris.opt, this is the executable target implementation file: it defines CRIS backend hook functions, option-finalization logic, asm emission helpers, calling-convention/frame code, and the post-delay-slot RTL pass in C++ rather than declaring macros, describing instruction patterns, or listing options.
